notes: Racing's own boundary rule sends this to Simulation: the scored activity is holding a wheelie for style points in free roam, not a lap or a finish line, and the ten locations are riding environments — city streets, skatepark, parking lots, trails — rather than tracks. Racing is named second and genuinely earns it through Time Trial, drift and AI-rider races, but letting it lead would import the genre-wide P6 that lays a track down procedurally, which is the wrong build for a free-roam playground; that is also why I took only checkpoint-respawn from its table (the prompt's looping respawn restores position, orientation and zeroed velocity verbatim) and left start, finish and lap triggers out. Vehicle Sim keeps its default world-open shape with the roads and highways as path-road-vehicle, the ragdoll crashes and skatepark ramps as physics-rig, and the stated few-block city as settlement-density; I dropped the preset's resource-shared since nothing is extracted. Routing P4 because the answers chose ten separate menu-selected maps rather than one connected world, plus tiered for the requested mountain roads and forest relief; with no user to ask I treated the bike customization and upgrade system as menu progression rather than a built showroom, so no hub zone was added.
